explication: Han1meViewer is an Android client for browsing, searching, viewing, and managing public video-page content. Its main workflow runs from Compose navigation and screens through business logic to network retrieval and HTML parsing, then presents domain data in the UI. Separate branches cover playback, account and community features, and background downloads. The README documents these layer relationships and product capabilities; source excerpts chiefly confirm file management, download persistence/orchestration, settings routes, and backup. Other feature links are shown only where the README describes them.
